function.description: Read what has been said in a group/channel room you are in: the most recent lines from the local room ledger, newest last. Each line carries {uid=… msg=…} for room_moderate. Read-only — to reply, use message(surface='telegram', target=<chat_id>) or answer a mention in the room. Omit `room` to list your rooms.
function.name: room_read

limit.description: How many of the most recent lines to return (1-200).

room.description: Which allowlisted room to read: the chat id, 'surface:chat_id', or a distinctive fragment of its name or of the owner's label for it. Omit to list the rooms you are in with their line counts.

since_minutes.description: Only lines newer than this many minutes. Omit for the plain most-recent window.
